data.name: Pentad - Eons of Time
data.detailed_description:
Pentad - Eons of Time

The ultimate re-imagining of the classic falling-block puzzle. Epic cosmic lore. Endless depth. One of the most ambitious puzzle experiences ever created.

About This Game

Before the stars burned and time began, the Auric Order forged the Caelus Engine — the machine that birthed universes. When their final experiment went cataclysmic, the Engine shattered into 33,333 fragments scattered across reality.

You are the explorer hunting these fragments. Every level is a new piece of the puzzle. Every clear brings you closer to rebuilding creation itself.

Pentad - Eons of Time is not just another Tetris clone. It’s a fusion of retro puzzle mastery and cosmic ambition — “AI-Retro” at its finest.

  • Thousands of hand-curated levels with stunning animated cosmic backgrounds

  • Hundreds of unique blocks and gameplay mechanics that evolve as you progress

  • Deep progression tied to an epic universe-spanning story

  • A game built to last: massive free updates planned for years

Whether you’re a puzzle veteran craving new challenges or a casual player looking for satisfying “just one more level” gameplay, Pentad - Eons of Time delivers.

We don’t know exactly what Pentad - Eons of Time will become… and that’s the best part. Help us discover it.

Key Features

  • Addictive Core Gameplay — Refined falling-block action with fresh twists and never-before-seen mechanics

  • Cosmic Visuals — Thousands of beautiful, animated backgrounds pulled from the fabric of creation

  • Epic Soundtrack — Original generative-inspired music that evolves with your journey (full soundtrack available)

  • Leaderboards — Compete globally for high scores on every level

  • Massive Scale — Initial release + thousands more levels coming. 30,000+ levels envisioned across the full vision

  • Living Game — Regular major updates: new modes, multiplayer, co-op, controller support, and more (full roadmap below)

  • Replayability — Multiple play modes and endless challenge

Old-school keyboard mastery (controller support coming soon). Pure focus. Pure fun.

The Roadmap (2026–2027 and Beyond)

We’re in this for the long haul:

  • Full sound effects suite

  • Multiplayer & Co-op modes

  • Three distinct play modes

  • Completely new gameplay layers beyond classic falling blocks

  • Fully animated levels

  • Controller support

  • iOS / iPad version

  • 4K Ultra edition

  • In-game upgrades & competitions with real prizes

Your purchase today funds a game that will grow for years.

AI-Generated Content Disclosure

We used AI tools to help generate background images and music during development (over 20,000 images and hundreds of hours of music created). All assets were carefully selected and edited by hand. The game itself uses only pre-rendered content — no real-time generation during gameplay.

Who This Game Is For

  • Fans of classic puzzle games, and modern takes on retro

  • Players who love deep, evolving experiences and cosmic storytelling

  • Anyone who appreciates a game that respects your time and rewards mastery

Ready to help rebuild the Engine of Creation?

Add to Wishlist • Buy Now for $1.99

(Bundle option: Game + Soundtrack)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 | AMD FX-6350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 | AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780, 3 GB | AMD Radeon R9 290X, 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
